snippet.title: Smalland: Survive the Wilds - Nintendo Switch 2 Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Smalland: Survive the Wilds is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 this spring! 

Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land. All available on the go on Nintendo Switch 2.
